summary: All three prior review issues have been addressed. The implementation is correct, secure, and well-tested. No new security, correctness, or robustness issues found.

details.prior_issue_1_auto_commit: RESOLVED. auto_commit_worktree() now uses check_phase_file_restrictions() from phase_filter (same function used at push time), filters files into allowed/blocked lists, restores blocked files via git checkout, stages only allowed files (no git add -A), and pushes via gateway API when session credentials are available. session_manager.py correctly passes phase, session_token, and gateway_url to the function.
details.prior_issue_2_marker_files: RESOLVED. ensure_egg_state_dirs() now accepts a phase parameter and writes .egg-readonly marker files when phase=='implement'. Content includes phase name, directory path, restriction reason, and remediation guidance. container_spawner.py passes phase correctly. 14 test cases in test_marker_files.py validate content, per-directory creation, non-creation for other phases, chown behavior, and idempotency.
details.prior_issue_3_enforce_mode: RESOLVED. EGG_AGENT_RESTRICTIONS_ENFORCE env var in gateway.py controls enforcement (accepts true/1/yes, default false). Enforce mode returns 403 with audit log; warn-only mode logs warning and allows push. 7 test cases in test_agent_restrictions_enforce.py cover both modes, flag values, unknown roles, and no-role scenarios.
details.prior_observation_4th_dir: RESOLVED. _IMPLEMENT_READONLY_DIRS now includes 'pipelines' (4 directories total). Tests verify the count.
details.security_review: No injection vulnerabilities found. _push_via_gateway() uses urllib.request with JSON payload (no shell commands). gateway_url is constructed from localhost + GATEWAY_PORT constant, not user input. session_token is passed from the existing session manager. Phase filter uses fail-open for import failure (acceptable since push-time validation remains the authoritative gate) and fail-closed for unknown phases. Path normalization prevents traversal attacks in both FileRestriction and PhaseFileRestriction.
details.correctness_review: git status porcelain parsing handles renames, short lines, and various status codes correctly. The blocked_files list comparison in auto_commit_worktree uses list membership (O(n) per check) which is acceptable for typical file counts. The fail-open behavior when phase_filter import fails is documented and acceptable since push-time validation is the authoritative control.
details.testing_coverage: Comprehensive test coverage across 5 new test files: test_post_agent_commit.py (30 tests), test_post_agent_commit_extended.py (11 tests), test_agent_restrictions_enforce.py (7 tests), test_phase_filter_restrictions.py (30+ tests), test_marker_files.py (14 tests). Edge cases including checkout failures, push failures, empty branch names, multiple blocked files, and import failures are all covered.
details.other_changes: Remaining changes are type annotation improvements (cast() additions, dict->dict[str, Any], list->list[Any]), formatting fixes (ruff reformatting), and documentation updates. These are mechanical and correct. The pyproject.toml removal of external=['EGG100'] is a cleanup. The transcript_extractor.py change to use datetime.now(UTC) as fallback for None timestamps fixes a potential type error.
